prompt: You cut a square of side $x$ inches from each corner of a $12$-inch by $12$-inch piece of cardboard and fold up the sides. The volume is $V(x) = x(12 - 2x)^2$. What is the volume in cubic inches when $x = 2$?
hint: Substitute $x = 2$ everywhere, then follow the order of operations — the parentheses first.

hints.text: Substitute $x = 2$ everywhere, then follow the order of operations — the parentheses first.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Warm up with $V(x) = x(6 - 2x)^2$ at $x = 1$: inside is $6 - 2 = 4$, squared is 16, times 1 is 16. Same three steps here.
Inside: $12 - 2(2) = 8$. Square it: $8^2 = 64$. Now multiply by $x = 2$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Build the box in your head
steps: Cutting 2 inches off BOTH ends of a 12-inch side leaves a base of $12 - 4 = 8$ inches.
The folded-up walls are 2 inches tall.
Volume = length × width × height = $8 \times 8 \times 2 = 128$ cubic inches.
